propositions: Jira work currently retries across nested loops with multiplied ownership, no stable per-ticket versus batch scope, and no endpoint-failure fuse; a provider-neutral coordinator with immutable TicketPlan values and one three-call/15-second retry budget per logical postcondition must replace scattered retry logic.

The coordinator must classify outcomes (auto-healed, retryable, permanent, commit-unknown, local, endpoint, tenant, provider, global) with exact per-ticket and pass tallies, honor provider-specified lower bounds via retry_not_before, and defer long waits rather than retrying early.

A new endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger only after three consecutive exhausted eligible logical outcomes across at least two tickets, distinct from the retained per-pass blast-radius guard, and matching success resets the scope.

Create operations must use label-first containment (rebar-id:<local_id>), optional property enrichment, known-key safety-abort, and commit-unknown recovery via the RP-02 transaction seam without duplicate creates after timeout or persistence failure.

The Cloud ACLI/REST and Jira DC adapters must disable hidden SDK retry (proven via offline _session.max_retries == 0 test against jira 3.10.5), execute within the three-call/15-second budget, and handle provider decoding; core owns re-observation/replanning, dependency deferral, and exact outcomes.

binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary() must remain ordered AFTER ensure_selection_current (staleness gate) and BEFORE the first remote issue fetch in reconcile.py without exceeding the 800-line cap, with boundary tests re-anchored in test_recovery_write_boundary.py.
